subject: general
question: The amount obtained by investing a certain sum in 4(3)/(4) years at 12% p.a.at simple interest is Rs. 2,175 more than the simple interest on the same sum in 11 years at the same rate. The sum (in Rs.) is:
solution:
**Given:**

Principal and Rate of interest is same for both the cases.

Rate of interest = 12% p.a.

Case 1: Duration of investment (T₁) = 11 years

Case 2: Duration of investment (T₂) = 4(3)/(4) years 

Total amount after T2 time

⇒ SI on Case 1 + Rs. 2175

**Concept used:**

SI = (P × T × R)/100

Amount = P + SI

Here, P = Principal, T = Time (in years), R = Rate of interest

**Calculation:**

Let the sum be Rs. P 

According to the question,

{P + P × (19/4) × (12/100)} - P × 11 × (12/100) = 2175

⇒ P + 57P/100 - 132P/100 = 2175

⇒ (100P + 57P - 132P)/100 = 2175

⇒ 25P/100 = 2175

⇒ P/4 = 2175

⇒ P = 2175 × 4 = 8700

So, the sum is Rs. 8700

**∴ The sum (in Rs.) is 8700.**
